summary: Public search indexes Editor.js body text with documented ranking, and each channel exposes a dedicated RSS feed alongside site-wide /rss.xml.
detailed_changes: Added posts.body_text denormalized on save (and migration backfill) so search matches published post body blocks, not only title/excerpt.
Documented search relevance: title, then excerpt, then body, then newest published_at (see docs/search.md).
Added per-channel RSS at /{channel}/rss.xml via the shared RssFeedBuilder; site-wide /rss.xml unchanged.
affected_areas: User groups affected: public readers discovering posts; feed subscribers by channel
Public impact: deeper search matches; channel-scoped RSS feeds
Internal impact: body_text maintained automatically on post save/import
